D_EFW_E02_S01_01.text: He thought waiting would kill everyone.

D_EFW_E02_S01_02.text: Someone was still getting people out.

D_EFW_E02_S01_05.text: Both of you stop trying to make the other one wrong.

D_EFW_E02_S01_06.text: Then tell us which one happened.

D_EFW_E02_S02_01.text: If we leave it breathing, it spreads.

D_EFW_E02_S02_04.text: And you always ask me to end something.

D_EFW_E02_S02_05.text: Because some things only stop when somebody does.

D_EFW_E02_S02_06.text: That's what frightens me about you.

D_EFW_E02_S03_01.text: Still talking about me like I'm late to my own funeral?

D_EFW_E02_S03_04.text: People are always leaving when you arrive.

D_EFW_E02_S03_07.text: No. We keep saying enough and then meeting again over another burning world.

D_EFW_E02_S03_08.text: Maybe because you keep burning them.

D_EFW_E02_S04_01.text: You brought me here to change my mind.

D_EFW_E02_S04_02.text: I brought you here so they weren't numbers when you decide.

D_EFW_E02_S04_05.text: And if you can't hold it?

D_EFW_E02_S04_06.text: Then I'll know who I failed.

D_EFW_E02_S05_03.text: No. You looked at maps. Look at what waiting leaves behind.

D_EFW_E02_S05_04.text: And you think ending this fixes those places?

D_EFW_E02_S05_05.text: I think there can still be places left to fix.

D_EFW_E02_S06_01.text: One hour. Both of you stand down.

D_EFW_E02_S06_03.text: And every time you cut it short.

D_EFW_E02_S06_04.text: Every time you mistake delay for mercy.

D_EFW_E02_S06_05.text: Every time you mistake an ending for a solution.

D_EFW_E02_S06_06.text: Do either of you remember how to speak to each other without a battlefield between you?

D_EFW_E02_S07_02.text: Don't look back at me. Look at the person in front of you.

D_EFW_E02_S08_03.text: You know what happens if I wait.

D_EFW_E02_S08_04.text: I know what happens when you don't.

D_EFW_E02_S08_05.text: I used to trust you to know when enough was enough.

D_EFW_E02_S08_06.text: I used to trust you to know the difference between courage and impatience.

D_EFW_E02_S08_07.text: Then we both remember better days.

D_EFW_E02_S10_04.text: No. You're looking at what didn't happen.

D_EFW_E02_S10_05.text: And you're looking only at what did.

D_EFW_E02_S10_06.text: That's how this war keeps us.

D_EFW_E02_S11_04.text: I remember Redlin carrying a little girl.

D_EFW_E02_S12_01.text: How can we remember the same day from different places?

D_EFW_E02_S12_02.text: Because a day doesn't belong to one person.
